records.source: Luau
records.translation: Luau
records.preserveReason: Canonical festival name retained as “Luau” in the approved Filipino glossary.

records.source: What a lovely occasion... It's always a joy to visit Stardew Valley.#$e#I must speak to the missus about purchasing a vacation home here.
records.translation: Napakagandang okasyon... Lagi akong nasisiyahang dumalaw sa Stardew Valley.#$e#Kailangan kong kausapin ang misis tungkol sa pagbili ng bahay-bakasyunan dito.

records.source: Don't let me stop you from having fun today. I just feel like watching the sea by myself.
records.translation: Huwag mong hayaang pigilan kita sa pagsasaya ngayon. Gusto ko lang pagmasdan ang dagat nang mag-isa.

records.source: It's nice to see everyone once in a while, but mostly I want to get back to the farm.
records.translation: Masarap makita ang lahat paminsan-minsan, pero higit sa lahat, gusto ko nang bumalik sa bukid.

records.source: Harvey keeps trying to talk to me, but all I want is a piece of this roast.
records.translation: Patuloy akong kinakausap ni Harvey, pero isang piraso lang ng inihaw na ito ang gusto ko.

records.source: I'm just humoring some old friends. What I really want is a bowl of that soup.
records.translation: Pinakikisamahan ko lang ang ilang dating kaibigan. Ang talagang gusto ko ay isang mangkok ng sabaw na iyon.

records.source: Phew... I'm afraid to move, or else I might start to sweat.
records.translation: Hay... Natatakot akong gumalaw dahil baka pagpawisan ako.

records.source: I'm doing my best to stay in a good mood...
records.translation: Ginagawa ko ang lahat para manatiling maganda ang timpla ko...

records.source: I guess it wouldn't be very nice to put something nasty in the soup...
records.translation: Mukhang hindi magandang maglagay ng nakakadiring bagay sa sabaw...

records.source: Hey, I'll take any excuse to come hang out at the beach. This weather is amazing!
records.translation: Hoy, sasamantalahin ko ang anumang dahilan para tumambay sa Dalampasigan. Napakaganda ng panahon!

records.source: Oh dear... I've got sand in my socks...$s
records.translation: Naku... Pinasok ng buhangin ang mga medyas ko...$s

records.source: The old cabin seems to be holding up well. Every time I return I half expect the thing to be rotted...
records.translation: Mukhang matibay pa rin ang lumang kubo. Sa tuwing bumabalik ako, halos inaasahan kong naaagnas na ito...

records.source: It's tiring to socialize with everyone... I'd rather watch the sea.
records.translation: Nakakapagod makihalubilo sa lahat... Mas gugustuhin kong pagmasdan ang dagat.

records.source: %She's unresponsive.
records.translation: %Hindi siya tumutugon.

records.source: Ow... you stepped on my foot, dear.
records.translation: Aray... natapakan mo ang paa ko, mahal.

records.source: This is tiring, honey. Are you ready to visit the buffet soon? *pant*
records.translation: Nakakapagod ito, mahal. Handa ka na bang pumunta sa handaan maya-maya? *hingal*

records.source: Whatever Linus is roasting smells awfully good... *slurp*
records.translation: Napakasarap ng amoy ng iniihaw ni Linus... *lunok-laway*

records.source: One year Sam put a pound of anchovies in the potluck soup.#$e#Ever wondered why Sam leads the town in community service hours?$h
records.translation: Isang taon, naglagay si Sam ng isang libra ng dilis sa sabaw para sa salu-salo.#$e#Naisip mo na ba kung bakit si Sam ang may pinakamaraming oras ng serbisyo sa komunidad sa bayan?$h

records.source: A slow, continuous rotation is key to achieving the perfect roast.
records.translation: Mabagal at tuloy-tuloy na pag-ikot ang susi sa perpektong pag-ihaw.

records.source: Hmm... maybe if I get on the governor's good side he'll give my business a tax break...#$b#I wonder if he likes aged whiskey?#$e#Now if only the Mayor would stop shmoozing with him all afternoon.
records.translation: Hmm... baka bigyan ng Gobernador ng bawas sa buwis ang negosyo ko kung mapalapit ako sa kaniya...#$b#Mahilig kaya siya sa pinatandang wiski?#$e#Kung titigil lang sana ang Alkalde sa pakikipagpalagayang-loob sa kaniya buong hapon.

records.source: I put fresh vegetables from my garden into the communal soup pot.
records.translation: Naglagay ako ng sariwang gulay mula sa hardin ko sa panlahatang kaldero ng sabaw.

records.source: Perfect weather for a beach party, huh?
records.translation: Perpekto ang panahon para sa party sa Dalampasigan, hindi ba?

records.source: That music! It's too loud.#$b#Can't I have a little peace and quiet to enjoy the ocean?
records.translation: Ang musikang iyan! Napakalakas.#$b#Hindi ba ako maaaring magkaroon ng kaunting katahimikan para masdan ang karagatan?

records.source: Ahh... The smell of the ocean takes me back many years. Long before you were born.
records.translation: Ahh... Ibinabalik ako ng amoy ng karagatan sa napakatagal nang nakaraan. Bago ka pa ipinanganak.

records.source: Look sharp! The governor's here for his annual visit.#$b#If you brought something for the potluck make sure and add it to the soup cauldron.
records.translation: Maging maayos kayo! Narito ang Gobernador para sa taunang pagdalaw niya.#$b#Kung may dinala ka para sa salu-salo, tiyaking ilagay iyon sa kaldero ng sabaw.

records.source: I'm full, but what else is there to do besides eat?
records.translation: Busog na ako, pero ano pa ba ang magagawa rito bukod sa kumain?

records.source: We do this festival every year to give the governor a taste of everything the valley has to offer.#$e#Mayor Lewis hopes it will get the governor on our good side. That's why he's so neurotic about the way the soup tastes.
records.translation: Ginaganap natin ang pistang ito bawat taon para matikman ng Gobernador ang lahat ng maihahandog ng lambak.#$e#Umaasa si Alkalde Lewis na mapapanig sa atin ang Gobernador. Kaya balisang-balisa siya tungkol sa lasa ng sabaw.

records.source: Heh... free buffet. One of the perks of living here. Enjoy it, kid!
records.translation: Heh... libreng handaan. Isa sa mga pakinabang ng pagtira rito. Sulitin mo, bata!

records.source: I would dance, but I don't want to get sweaty.
records.translation: Sasayaw sana ako, pero ayokong pagpawisan.

records.source: I hope the soup is good this year.
records.translation: Sana masarap ang sabaw ngayong taon.

records.source: Hey, good to see you.
records.translation: Hoy, masaya akong makita ka.

records.source: I'll be back here by the trees... the air is a lot cooler.
records.translation: Dito ako sa likuran, malapit sa mga puno... mas malamig ang hangin.

records.source: Governor? Who cares...#$e#Why should I care about some random old guy?
records.translation: Gobernador? Sino ang may pakialam...#$e#Bakit ako magmamalasakit sa kung sinong matandang lalaki?

records.source: How's the farming coming along? It must be a busy season for you.
records.translation: Kumusta ang pagsasaka? Tiyak na abalang panahon ito para sa iyo.

records.source: Wow... you don't get hot pepper chutney like this in the big city...
records.translation: Wow... walang ganitong chutney ng sili sa malaking lungsod...

records.source: If you brought something for the soup, climb the stairs on the other side and throw it in.
records.translation: Kung may dinala ka para sa sabaw, umakyat ka sa hagdan sa kabilang panig at ihulog iyon.

records.source: I woke up late, stepped out of the door and found myself in the middle of all this hubbub!#$e#I forgot that today was the Luau.$h
records.translation: Nahuli akong nagising, lumabas sa pinto, at nasumpungan ang sarili ko sa gitna ng lahat ng kaguluhang ito!#$e#Nakalimutan kong Luau ngayon.$h

records.source: These blasted sand-flies keep landing on the food!
records.translation: Paulit-ulit na dumadapo sa pagkain ang mga pesteng langaw-buhangin na ito!

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: The merpeople are curious about your festivities.#$e#They become upset when you litter into the ocean.
records.translation: Interesado ang mga taong-dagat sa pagdiriwang ninyo.#$e#Nagagalit sila kapag nagtatapon kayo ng basura sa karagatan.

records.source: Good thing I came with sunscreen.#$e#I wonder if Maru could use some sunscreen on her shoulders?
records.translation: Mabuti na lang at may dala akong panangga sa araw.#$e#Kailangan kaya ni Maru ng kaunting panangga sa araw sa mga balikat niya?

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s
